name: zanoba
description: Zanoba — a tutoring platform. The app lives in apps/web.

scripts.dev: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.build: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.publish:worksheet: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run publish --
scripts.lesson:now: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run lesson:now --
scripts.check:worksheet: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run check:worksheet
scripts.check:fit: node scripts/require-node.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web run check:fit --
